coverage.note: ratings are relative to the field a rider met; they are not comparable across classes

method.continuity: one rating per class across all seasons; changing a plate number does not restart it
method.entrant: a new rider enters at the class median and the scale starts at 1500
method.glicko: Glicko-2 over the same pairwise moto comparisons, with an initial deviation of 350 and tau 0.5; the deviation is the point — it says how settled the number is
method.model: Elo, every finisher compared with every other finisher in the same moto
